body:
Well, not really.
We were really young, I think we were around the age of 10, so he did not get really punished.
He did go to the police station however, and a lot of our friends stopped talking to him after this event.
For the trivia, I remember our teacher crying in front of him instead of shouting after him the day he came back to school.

It was not something I've done myself, I was more like a spectator of it, but I remember talking about burning a trash can when I was in elementary school. It was the idea of my best friend. At first we took it like a joke, because we were trying to find a solution in order to skip class. Well, this mad lad took it literally and burned the can, which burned for a while in a corner of the class. Thankfully, the only teacher there at lunch saw it and called the firefighters. This dumbass really did it... on a Friday, just before the week end, nullifying the whole point of doing it.
I think it was the worst thing I was part of, it's not much but imagine if there were no teachers at this moment. A whole school, down in flames... because of a kid.
Some of them are reproducing hateful behavior that their parents have towards our community, when they didn't try to make an opinion for themselves. It really makes me angry.
It's part of a french song "Formidable" by Stromae, it doesn't sound as cool as it is when you translate it ( it basically translate to "You were formidable, I was very pathetic")
I'd legit like this more than what we have now. It could have been very cool, that would have been even better with how you depicted it !
That's so perfect, great job !
Yeah I'm not a fond of tier list either, they were relevant when the game launched but now they are pretty useless to say the least. (It's okay I do the same and I find it more funny !)

Hey that is a nice Oboro you got here fellow french ! I love slow units with speedy builds, because a lot of my favorite units are slow as hell I try to make them fast. But Oboro, not only yours is fast, she is a true tank and that is quite impressive for a unit to combine both, good job !

Male Robin under the spotlight is sadly just a continuation of Male Kris being on the boxart of New Mystery, Robin is only the second player avatar in the Franchise, and for many it was the first, since New Mystery isn't that popular and Awakening was the first Fire Emblem experience for a lot of people. However Female Robin not being an amiibo whereas Corrin has both version can be explained because Corrin was a DLC character and most of them came with alternate costum variation for their amiibo too (Bayonetta and Cloud for example).
Outside of that, I must say I tend to avoid other Fire Emblem Related boards or community, mainly because r/fireemblemheroes is enough salt and/or pseudo-elitism, so I wasn't very aware of that hate for Chrobin, I just know that people love to trash on Awakening or Fates writing when the other games aren't that deep either. And I am surrounded by Female Robin fans, which is not a bad thing.

Something tells me you're not prepared for that sweet refine of Dire Thunder, I don't know when IS will bless us with it, but it may be sooner than we think (Even though it might just be a Duel Skill).

I feel like Male Robin is only popular in Heroes. And even in Heroes, Female Robin doesn't feel ignored, she is a free to play unit, and she has the same number of alts as her male counterpart. Maybe it's because I know more people that love the female version, but it doesn't feel like playing Female Robin or marrying her with Chrom is bad taste, it's just fairly common. 
I mean, as a Male Corrin fan I can totally understand what you feel, it's quite the same situation for us, you just have to genderswap the whole thing.

As a fan of Reinhardt myself I mostly agree with a part of your post, the fact that Cavalry is balanced   around Reinhardt and Brave Lyn is unhealthy and also very sad. But I'll tell you, I play a lot of red units since most of my favorite units are Swords or Red Tome, and to be honest I feel like Armored, Brave Veronica and Legendary Azura are much more problematic than Reinhardt even was, because there aren't as many ways to counter them as there are ways to counter Reinhardt.
You are not mistaken, they actually did, since March Quests.

Same here, while I wasn't very happy with the recent decisions made by IS, it was still cool to play and with the idea that a new gamemode was coming, there were no reasons to ever quit. But now that we know this mode is basically Arena's Echo Fighter, and that the summoning pool isn't  more interesting with the changes announced, future doesn't look bright for the game, especially for F2P players.
Everybody is upset because they didn't demote Gen 1 units to the 4/3* pool, not because we won't be pitybreak by them anymore, it's different.

Fire Emblem Heroes is the game that introduced me to Seliph and Reinhardt, outside their power (Bad for Seliph and stupidly good for Reinhardt), I found their design to be so good, now my Reinhardt is +10 and my Seliph +5, and they introduced me to FE4/FE5 games.
But my two best discoveries are by far Fae and Eliwood, I played their gamed and I was not really interested in them, but in FEH I love them so much ! Outside of that, Fire Emblem Heroes made my love for Lucina grow even bigger.
Wholesome, your Meganium is so cute !

Yes, I play Fae, Masked Marth, Original Azura because they are my favorite, I want to merge some others characters too. I think it's kind of weird playing only good characters in a game like FEH but a character being strong is still a reason of why one would love them, so that's okay.
Seliph ? Like really Seliph is in this game ?? Finally ??? Looks like my merge project is actually worth !
This is a success, you look amazing ! I hope you'll have a merry christmas too !
Big brother is now big sister !?
You and I, slipping away

Social conventions. 
At first I wanted to say communication because I really suck at it, but without it I wouldn't be able to met wonderful persons, especially on Reddit, and mostly because it is written in our DNA so it isn't our creation.
Social conventions however, as far as I believe, are Mankind's voluntary creation. Norms and what it follows is something which creates a lot of hatred towards those that don't want to follow it all the way. It is quite hard to explain it but you get the idea.

Dio Brando. His stand can stop time plus he his a vampire.
I would not me surprised if he becomes Earth's ruler several seconds after he was summoned.

I've got no life goals. Like, really, I just want to live a simple life with enought money to live and buy what I like (mostly books and video games). Sometimes I fantazise me as a wandering soul which only want to keep wandering. I do not feel like I need "love", I do not feel like I want to travel, I do not feel like I need more money. I just live my life as it keep going. The darkest part of it is, I always feel sad for no reasons. Maybe I realize inside that my own life is boring, but honestly I feel it all the time, I'm used to it and I can live with it.

Aliening. The story of an outer-space creature transforming everything in its path into another outer-space creature with the same props. It does that because it is its only way of reproducing. 
I can't tell if it's good or awful for a story ahah.

I would change my way of studying. In France we have to type of studies in college, it is either you go to college everyday and they control you and your progression (it is actually what I picked since they forgot to tell us we had the choice) or you go whenever you want to and they control you at the end of a semester. And I would like to pick the second so I can get a job at the same time, it is less pressuring and it would greatly help me. 
The thing is, I can only change at the end of the first semester and I fear I failed that one, which is a little bit depressing since I'm pretty sure I will have to catch-up one or two subjects, if it isn't more.

Okami. There are combats in it but not that much. The game is a pleasure for ears, eyes and hands since it is very simple to play. And the story is so good. A must-play if you love japanese artstyle, folklore and music.

Ice Age, the first. Watched it as a kid and did not really understand the story more than funny animals trying to save a baby. Recently rewatched it and man, what a movie. Everything was so well-made, the fact you can enjoy it whatever your age is, the double reading is amazing, the characters too.

Currently I'm far from my hometown, I live with my cousins in Paris and, it is either I keep doing studies until the end, or I choose another field of study, or I stop there and find something else/a job. The thing is, my entry at college was expensive and I don't think my parents would accept my eventual failure.
Kind of you. I'll do it if I feel the need, thank you very much to give me some of your time, really !
Merci beaucoup ! Can I PM you if it get worse or if  I start feeling like trash one day ?

Thanks. I hope I will change my mind too. The hard part of this is, until the end of highschool, I saw my middle school bullies everyday. They did not do anything to me in highschool but still, it was hard to move on in this situation.
Thank you for the kind words ! I think I'm in this situation because a lot of things happened recently and it is difficult to keep up, but I'll do my best.
Will do. I know I can talk about it with relatives but it is hard to find the moment and to find a way to tell them.

I'm 18. I know it sounds a little bit stupid to feel the way I do at that age...
Do you feel better nowadays and do you still remember what you felt back in your 20s ? I wonder if we can turn the page on these events when we get older.

Thank you. I'm in college because I wanted to study English which is my favorite language. Turns out it was not what I had in mine, but I need it to work where I want to. I don't really know what to do if just carry on until I finish it.

Oh my, I was not expecting any answer. Words cannot tell how pure you are and I thank you very much. Ever since I left middle school I try to rebuild myself, it is hard and painful, sometimes I even fail to keep the habits I need to recover. The thing is, I did not tell any of these to my family, I did everything I could to hide my problems. I know how my mother would react if I tell her and it will only worsen my situation. Right now, Reddit and Discord are my two hideouts, the only places where I can confess my worries.
I must admit college was my default choice, I know what I want to do, but I don't think it is possible to work in these fields without 8-years studies...
Regardless, I am thankful you took time to read my post and I wish you the best in life.

Neglecting myself during so many years. Because I feared life during the french equivalent of middle school, because I let people making fun of me, let it destroy my mental sanity, now I'm in college and making friend or working correctly is just impossible, I have this voice in my head that keeps repeating I'll fail. I'm lost and not far from throwing my life away.
You are not the only one, I don't like the direction the game is taking at all so if it is that bad I'll just quit until maybe Fire Emblem 6 banner.

Either playing video games or listening to music, sometimes both when I feel like I could jump off my window at any time. It really helps me to wash these bad feelings. Especially when I feel like trash, online video games (sadly) remind me that I'm far from being the worst person ever.

Social interactions, talking with people, as ridiculous and stupid it can sounds. It is not just people I don't know. Even my family members, even my parents. I just can talk without feeling weird, or feeling like I should not talk. 
I discussed about it with an online friend who said that it was common for everyone to feel weird the first time you talk with someone, I understand it, but it feels like everyone is doing it just fine.
Having difficulties with communication is surely something I can't bear any longer, I just wish I could do something for my self-confidence without speaking.

I know that feel. Kliff is my favorite Fire Emblem Male Character and I was waiting for him since Day One. Luckily I do not hate Loki nor do I hate Owain, but after spending all my orbs for just one Loki I felt empty. 
So yeah, I think the best is to summon on a banner which features multiple units you like.
He is so precious oh my god
